description: A 20x20 box with transform: translate(15px, 10px) -- proves the box paints at its translated position (not its untransformed layout position) and that the reported box geometry moves with it, matching a real getBoundingClientRect().

classification.reason: Same anti-aliasing/hinting mismatch between Chromium's own rasterizer and Florui's skrifa+tiny-skia one already calibrated for the bare-element fixtures -- this fixture has no text, only a flat translated fill, so the real number is expected to land near the low end of that range.
